scenario: During a casual gathering at a local community center, Agent1 observes Agent2 letting out a big belch without excusing themselves. Agent1, who values manners and etiquette, feels the need to address this behavior as it might affect the comfort of others in the community space. Agent1 decides to approach Agent2 in a non-confrontational manner to discuss the importance of manners in shared spaces. Both agents are regulars at the community center and know each other by name but have not interacted much beyond casual greetings.
learner_goal: Educate Agent2 on the importance of good manners in a community space and encourage them to be more mindful of their actions (<extra_info>Extra information: Agent1 believes that everyone should contribute to a respectful and pleasant environment.</extra_info>, <clarification_hint>Clarification hint: Agent1 should approach the topic with sensitivity to avoid embarrassing Agent2.</clarification_hint>)

transcript.speaker: Leo Williams
transcript.content: Hey Liam — can I mention something quick? I noticed that big belch earlier. I know it happens, but in a shared space like this it can make others uncomfortable; would you mind saying “excuse me” next time so we keep the place pleasant for everyone (especially the families and kids)?

transcript.content: Hey Leo, thanks for the heads-up — sorry about that, wasn't trying to be rude. You're right; I'll make an effort to say 'excuse me' next time. Appreciate you looking out for the families.
